What to do

Review the recommended fix with the team responsible for the website.

narrative.overview: The locally built landing follows user-selected alternative 6, approved with ‘la 6 mi piace.’ Pearl surfaces, dark plum Manrope, coral emphasis, lilac panels and local optical artwork define this surface. It supersedes the landing’s earlier agency-journal proposal. The subsequent user approval “ok vai avanti” extends Prism to workspace and all remaining pages: quiet white and pearl operational surfaces, lilac selection and reading panels, rose actions, and preserved semantic statuses. Appearance approval does not authorize deployment. Reports extend Prism in Read mode: a conclusion and honest action/decision/reference counts, up to three linked priorities, two-column consequence and action explanations, and visible evidence. The public fictional sample shares the production renderer. The local report finish review resolved print footer identity and long agency-header issues; appearance review does not authorize deployment.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl ground and dark plum Manrope.
Coral display emphasis with deeper rose actions.
Optical glass ring and softly lifted fictional portfolio overview.
Local font and artwork; responsive stacking and contained table scrolling.
Reports use a 1080px reading document, stacked findings at 700px, and agency identity preserved in A4 print.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status color accompanies readable status text; illustrations and fictional data remain explicitly identified.

rules.name: Report reading and print
rules.body: A4 margins: 15mm top/sides and 22mm bottom. The bottom-center page margin box repeats domain, agency and date with CSS hex-escaped identity text. Agency copy reserves 12rem right clearance on desktop and print, reset to zero on mobile. Up to eight reference items flow after findings; longer inventory starts a new page. Hide save/navigation in print, retain the fictional sample note.

dos: Do preserve the selected color hierarchy and local assets.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and fictional-data labels.
Do use 44px operational actions, 46px inputs, violet workspace focus and a wrapping mobile navigation header.
Do preserve self-contained generated-report styling, agency identity, severity text and print rules.
Do link the top three actionable priorities to full findings, preserve visible evidence and state missing guidance explicitly.
donts: Don't obscure operational evidence, navigation or report print behavior when applying Prism across routes.
Don't present the illustrative overview as delivered dashboard functionality.
Don't interpret appearance approval or the scoped ship review as deployment authorization.
Do not turn reference observations into passed security checks or introduce invented report scores, deadlines or guarantees.
